site: KIZA area (Santa Ynez, CA), field elevation 674 ft
weather: pilot-set clear/calm; recorded wind 1-2 kt, OAT ~4 C at 6,000 ft
split_from: data/raw/2026-10-31_stall_c172sp.jsonl (one recorder session, split by aircraft title; lines unchanged)
sign_conventions: raw MSFS: pitch_deg + = nose DOWN; bank_deg + = LEFT wing down; p_dps + = roll LEFT; r_dps + = yaw right; pedals/yoke_x + = right; yoke_y + = aft
markers: landing light was not used as a marker; no pause markers between points. points are identified by time.
local_only: the .jsonl is not in git (size); ask the pilot or re-record

segments.what: aircraft loaded in the air; spurious stall warning at 16:24:35 during load; climb
spin left, power off, clean: 3 turns; spiral tendency after turn 1 (AoA ~16, IAS rising)
spin right, power off, clean: 3.5 turns; same spiral tendency
power-on stall, clean: mild left wing drop 17 deg, then full left rudder spin 2.25 turns
full flaps, full RIGHT rudder: skid, then LEFT roll-off ~0.8 turn left; hands-off phugoid after recovery
full flaps, spin right 2.3 turns (more spin-like: AoA ~19, steady speed)
power-off stall, clean, no rudder: pitch break, 11 deg left wing drop
